Geometry quality and recovery

ORIGINAL BASELINES PRESERVED

Checking the saved geometry audit…

Registering all 500 frames does not guarantee valid camera positions. Some local camera and point groups collapsed to near-zero depth relative to the overall scene. The 4× dense stage stopped when these groups could not supply valid depth bounds. Its partial depth maps and both original sparse models are preserved.

A separate recovery screens collapsed or poorly supported cameras on copies, keeps points supported by at least two retained views, and checks positive depth ranges before continuing. It keeps the estimated OPENCV_FISHEYE calibration and original photograph resolution. Missing coverage is reported explicitly; screening is a repair, not measured room calibration.

Camera model and calibration assumptions

OPENCV_FISHEYE / ESTIMATED FOR THIS EXPORT

The inspected file is a flat 16:9, 3840 × 2160 HEVC export at 24 fps. Insta360 describes MegaView as 170°, and its FOV documentation describes export-time reframing. These sources do not supply a measured intrinsic matrix for this video.

The requested OPENCV_FISHEYE model uses fx, fy, cx, cy, k1, k2, k3, k4. Initialization assumes an equidistant horizontal 170° view, with fx = fy = width / radians(170), centered principal point and zero distortion coefficients. This horizontal interpretation is an approximation, not a manufacturer calibration. COLMAP estimates shared focal lengths and distortion; the principal point stays fixed. MegaView warping or changing FOV can limit the physical accuracy of a single shared fisheye model.

ParameterFull resolution: initial → estimated4×: initial → estimated

COLMAP camera models · OpenCV fisheye equations

SIFT: CUDA, a requested feature limit of 8,192, native image size. The table reports actual stored feature rows, which can exceed that setting after orientation assignment. Matching: custom sequential pairs, 15 neighboring frames, offsets 20/40/80/160/320, anchor links every 20 images, guided matching and geometric verification. Mapping: incremental, seed 0, 12 CPU threads. Refinement: Ceres bundle adjustment, then 4 px observation filtering and a 1.5° triangulation threshold. Dense: calibrated fisheye-to-pinhole undistortion, ten source views, CUDA geometric PatchMatch with five iterations, CPU fusion with a 12 GB cache, Poisson mesh depth 10.

gsplat from geometry-screened cameras

NATIVE PHOTOGRAPHS + SCREENED CAMERAS / RTX 4090

Training uses the source-derived calibrated undistorted images with matching pinhole cameras, at data_factor=1. This correctly converts fisheye pixels and camera matrices together. Each substantial component is trained separately for 30,000 steps on the RTX 4090: packed rendering, batch size 1, SH degree 3, seed 42, default densification, L1/SSIM weights 0.8/0.2, camera and appearance optimization disabled. Frames 1, 9, …, 497 are held out from Gaussian training; COLMAP used their geometry.

These are separate recovery runs using 320 retained cameras at 4× and 457 at native resolution. The original 500-view COLMAP models remain available above. Excluded camera coverage is not reconstructed by these runs. Validation subsets contain 40 and 55 source frames respectively, with 39 shared frames; comparisons of their aggregate scores are not controlled for the same views.

Validation scores describe held-out appearance, not measured 3D accuracy.
